stem: Clarissa needs a $2,500 loan in order to buy a car. Which loan option would allow her to pay the least amount of interest?

options.label: A
options.text: An 18-month loan with a 4.75% annual simple interest rate

options.label: B
options.text: A 30-month loan with a 4.00% annual simple interest rate

options.label: C
options.text: A 24-month loan with a 4.25% annual simple interest rate

options.label: D
options.text: A 36-month loan with a 4.50% annual simple interest rate
